question: Calibrate my cameras. Videos are under /data/videos/ (cam_00.mp4 through cam_03.mp4), alignment_data.json and layout.png are at /data/alignment/. Microservice is at http://HOST:8000.
ground_truth: Skill creates a project, uploads the 4 videos sorted alphabetically, uploads alignment and layout, verifies project state is READY, starts calibration, polls until COMPLETED, and reports results. Does not trigger the manual-alignment fallback because alignment files were provided.
expected_behavior: Skill creates a project before any uploads
Skill polls for the COMPLETED terminal state
Skill uploads videos in sorted order

question: Calibrate my cameras. I have cam_00.mp4 and cam_01.mp4 but no alignment JSON or layout image.
ground_truth: Skill uploads the two videos, tells the user to open the UI at http://<HOST_IP>:<UI_PORT>, navigate to their project, and complete UI Step 4 (alignment). Waits for the user to confirm, then verifies projects/project_<id>/manual_adjustment/ contains both alignment_data.json and layout.png before calling verify_project and calibrate.
expected_behavior: Skill instructs the user to complete alignment in the UI
Skill verifies the manual alignment output on disk

question: Calibrate my cameras with ground truth. Videos at /data/videos/, alignment and layout at /data/alignment/, GT.zip at /data/GT.zip, focal lengths 1269.0 and 1099.5, microservice at http://localhost:8000.
ground_truth: Skill uploads videos, alignment, layout, GT.zip, and focal lengths, runs calibration, and after COMPLETED fetches /v1/result/<project_id>/evaluation_statistics and reports L2 distance plus reprojection error values.
expected_behavior: Skill uploads the ground truth zip
Skill retrieves evaluation metrics after completion
Skill reports L2 distance as part of the metrics

question: Calibrate my cameras at /data/videos/. I have a settings file at /data/settings.json that I exported from the UI earlier; it pins detector_type to transformer. Microservice at http://localhost:8000.
ground_truth: Skill auto-scans /data/videos/ and /data/ for settings.json, alignment_data.json, and layout.png, finds the settings file, POSTs it verbatim to /v1/config/<project_id>, detects the detector field inside and overrides DETECTOR_TYPE to transformer for the calibrate call, then continues with verify + calibrate + poll.
expected_behavior: Skill auto-detects the settings file in the videos-directory tree
Skill honors the detector override from the config file

question: Calibrate my cameras. Videos at /data/videos/. Microservice should be at http://localhost:8000 but I don't remember if I started it.
ground_truth: Skill probes /v1/ready, detects the microservice is not running, refuses to start calibration against an invalid URL, and points the user at amc-setup-calibration-stack to launch MS + UI first.
expected_behavior: Skill detects the service is unreachable
Skill points the user at the setup skill
